corrections.reason: In Classical Ge'ez gerundive morphology, the form is 'ሐዊሮሙ' (having gone, 1st order ሐ), not 7th order ሖ; the image shows ሐ.
At the bottom of Column 3, the printed text is 'ተላጽቆተ ሥዓ-' wrapping onto the next page's 'ል' to form 'ተላጽቆተ ሥዓል' (persistent/importunate asking, Luke 11:8 commentary), not 'ሥጋ'.
